performance.verdict: Zero leads in 28 days is a tracking gap, not a campaign failure.

findings.text: lead_drought flag: all 28 days show 0 leads in series, yet GHL logged 41 opportunities and 13 won — tracking is broken, not pipeline.
SOW OVERDUE: Booking bot battle-test was due 2026-07-31 — no completed event recorded; speed-to-lead promise is unverified.
Intake ownership unconfirmed since Vivian left 7/7; GHL has 81 contacts but 0 appointments — speed-to-lead automations may be routing to an empty seat.
3-day spend signal (Aug 23–25): $62.48 + $16.46 + $15.83 = $94.77 vs prior 3 days (Aug 20–22): $16.06 + $21.63 + $84.70 = $122.39 — spend trending down 22%, consistent with intentional throttle.
GBP actions last 3 days (Aug 23–25) total 0, down from 22 in prior 3 days (Aug 20–22) — possible Windsor data lag flagged in SOW, not confirmed demand drop.

suggestions.text: Repair Google Ads conversion tracking: 12 conversions in platform vs 0 in leads series — audit the pixel or import source immediately.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads reports 12 conversions over 28 days but the leads series shows 0 for every day in the same window. Audit the conversion action source (call import, form submit, or LSA handoff) to confirm which events are being counted and why they are not flowing into the leads field. Success is confirmed when daily leads series matches GHL opportunity intake within a reasonable margin. Complete audit by 2026-08-29.

suggestions.text: Confirm live intake owner and GHL seat post-Vivian; 0 appointments logged against 41 opportunities is a confirmed intake leak.
suggestions.monday_update: Vivian left on 7/7 and no replacement intake owner has been confirmed in GHL. There are 41 opportunities created and 0 appointments logged in the 28-day window, meaning speed-to-lead automations are likely routing to an empty or unmonitored seat. Confirm the new owner's GHL login and after-hours coverage with Xavier or Nader. Success is at least 1 appointment logged per week once confirmed; verify by 2026-09-02.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP action recovery through 2026-08-29 before drawing conclusions; last 3-day zero may be Windsor lag per SOW note.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions over Aug 23–25 totalled 0, down from 22 in the prior 3 days, but the SOW explicitly flags Windsor data lag in the last 2–3 days of any GBP window. Do not treat this as a demand signal until the window refreshes. Re-check on 2026-08-29; if actions remain at or near 0 after lag clears, escalate as a confirmed GBP engagement drop.
